_comment: Hooks from everything-claude-code that were NOT wired into settings.json, because each one misfires on this specific repo. Paste an entry into the matching settings.json array to enable it.

_1_blocks_npm_run_dev._why_omitted: Hard-blocks `npm run dev` (exit 1) unless started via tmux. This project's dev entrypoint is `npm run dev` -> scripts/dev.mjs, so it would be unrunnable.
_1_blocks_npm_run_dev.matcher: tool == "Bash" && tool_input.command matches "(npm run dev|pnpm( run)? dev|yarn dev|bun run dev)"

hooks.command: node -e "console.error('[Hook] BLOCKED: Dev server must run in tmux for log access');console.error('[Hook] Use: tmux new-session -d -s dev \"npm run dev\"');console.error('[Hook] Then: tmux attach -t dev');process.exit(1)"

_1_blocks_npm_run_dev.description: Block dev servers outside tmux - ensures you can access logs

_2_blocks_writing_docs._why_omitted: Hard-blocks writing any .md/.txt except README/CLAUDE/AGENTS/CONTRIBUTING. This repo keeps real docs in docs/ (DEPLOYMENT.md, ADMIN-OPERATIONS.md, LESSON-PLANS.md, HARDENING-PASS-2.md), all of which would become unwritable.

hooks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const i=JSON.parse(d);const p=i.tool_input?.file_path||'';if(/\.(md|txt)$/.test(p)&&!/(README|CLAUDE|AGENTS|CONTRIBUTING)\.md$/.test(p)){console.error('[Hook] BLOCKED: Unnecessary documentation file creation');console.error('[Hook] File: '+p);console.error('[Hook] Use README.md for documentation instead');process.exit(1)}console.log(d)})"

_2_blocks_writing_docs.description: Block creation of random .md files - keeps docs consolidated

_3_full_typecheck_on_every_edit._why_omitted: Runs a full `npx tsc --noEmit` across the whole project after every single .ts edit. This codebase has ~60 source files and a full typecheck takes a noticeable pause, so it would tax every edit. `npm run typecheck` covers the same ground on demand.

hooks.command:
node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process');const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const i=JSON.parse(d);const p=i.tool_input?.file_path;if(p&&fs.existsSync(p)){let dir=path.dirname(p);while(dir!==path.dirname(dir)&&!fs.existsSync(path.join(dir,'tsconfig.json'))){dir=path.dirname(dir)}if(fs.existsSync(path.join(dir,'tsconfig.json'))){try{const r=execSync('npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false 2>&1',{cwd:dir,encoding:'utf8',stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe']});const lines=r.split('
').filter(l=>l.includes(p)).slice(0,10);if(lines.length)console.error(lines.join('
'))}catch(e){const lines=(e.stdout||'').split('
').filter(l=>l.includes(p)).slice(0,10);if(lines.length)console.error(lines.join('
'))}}}console.log(d)})"
